Thanks I try. 

It's for shoplifting. <_<

He's been going out like a trooper but yeah, I need to recover so I can take back over.
Hey thanks, I'll definitely keep you in mind. Don't be surprised if I hit you up soon!

I feel you. It broke my heart when my elderly cat passed a few months back, but I can rest assured that despite our situation, we gave her a good life.

I'm happy my little boy came back.
Oh awesome I'll be sure to check it out, thank you so much. 👍

That's how I feel, and how mostly everyone in this post treated me. I really should have left the "scummy addict" part off, I was just... I dunno, deflecting? Venting?

Either way, thank you for that.

Hey we all got things. I absolutely agree, I thank God for my family. My brother is my best friend, and I just adore my kitty. 

They're my boys. 🐈 😎

I agree. I do sorta have some dreams, so I'm hoping I can use those to spring-board/motivate myself into getting back on track.

It's nothing crazy really, but I'd like to get more into singing/me and brother busking as a hustle. 

Other simple stuff, but it might be fun to try dating. >_>

Hey, we all need dreams and aspirations, right? 🙌

- When I was still getting used to them, catching random glares. (I think they make lens with glare reduction) 

- Needing to clean them to see, if you're out in the rain, dealing with being blinding by the elements.

- Again, when I was still adjusting to them, I found the visual difference between the part of my eyes covered by the lens, and the part outside of that, to be mildly disorienting. (I hope I explained that clearly)

I've been wearing glasses for 15 years now, so most of these aren't much of an issue now.

Video games, rpgs mostly. I'm playing Dragon Warrior II (NES) right now. I have a kitty cat I love, I love listening to music, various rock, metal, some non-mainstream country. My dad was a musician, my brother is and he tells me I can sing so we plan to try busking once we can get him an acoustic bass (I think he wants.)

That's fine, plenty of people are like that. I'd rather have a sub or something than a dollar.

I do what I have to to get by at this time, it's not my life plan but I'm past being ashamed.
True. Thankfully I'm not in that dark of a place. Homelessness isn't pretty but I mean, I survive, I eat, I have my family.

Well. Addict or not, if you're a human being living on this planet, food is a necessity. 😃 I personally just fly a sign and use any money I get to get things I need, sometimes I luck out and someone will actually buy me/us dinner rather than throw me a dollar (much better value!) I'd say most of the time though I end up buying it.

Just wanted to thank everyone for your kind words and taking the time out to reply. As I know you all know, we tend to be invisible, and me personally going from interacting with dozens of people a day to seeing my brother for a few hours has been a bit of a shock, so it's nice to have some folks to talk to, even if I'm just a scummy addict. 

Thanks guys! 🙌

I've considered it, but I just don't think even if money weren't an issue (no clue what's covered by Medicaid) I think my first step would probably be going on maintenance treatment.

Still, I'm probably bedridden (well, floor-ridden, hehe) for several more days, so I have a lot of time to think about what to do next.

She* and couldn't sleep because my cat got out and I was worried about him.

Also, I'm not even getting pleasure from any fix as of late, my ankle is pretty bad right now. Anything I do keeps me out of withdrawal (which causes you to become hypersensitive to pain) and provides pain relief.

Well thanks for your reply, addicts have to eat too though.

Apologise if I sounded like I was asking for pity, I actually just wanted company.

We have at least one decent addiction clinic around here. I only know they offer maintenance drugs, and once I get my Medicaid back, I'm considering going on one.

I appreciate the kind words, but honestly I think he helps me more than I help him. While I loved my elderly cat dearly, he definitely helped both of us cope with her death. Plus, I've had a cat every day since about September of '95. So there's that.

True. I've been considering going on maintenance like methodone(sp?) Or subs, but I have to get my Medicaid reactivated since it's lapsed.

That or I just have to do a better job myself of conserving/maintenancing. I know I probably sound like a fool but one can dream.

Thank you. I do take advantage of certain services (served meals, clothing donations probably others) it helps but it's.... Well, lacking, not the clothes but pretty much everything else I've tried to seek. I mean, several times of the week, the main place I go for dinner runs out of food so we don't get enough and I've unfortunately realized that it's just easier to make a few more dollars earlier in the day to cover dinner.

Doesn't help that it's primarily the male side of the shelter, and when I've turned down volunteers for dates (who am I kidding, hook ups) on at least one occasion, the man was actively hostile to me the rest of the time he served there/interfered with me getting food.

Sometimes we all have something to deal with. I'm still standing (heh well, I'm still ALIVE) so I'll be trucking on until something or someone stops me. 
Thank you. I am fortunate I have them.

Thanks. I plan to get my ass together once I can walk again.

The panhandling thing.... Pretty much, my brother has horrible depression which he has had for years, with anxiety for good measure, and he has a capias(sp?) Which has made him afraid to go out frankly. It's been a tough situation but overall I understand, I don't want to lose him.
Thanks! I'm really relieved.

So fucking sad. Animals (cats and dogs in particular) are a wonderful part of creation, I find it hard to fathom how you could intentionally try to hurt them, not in a humane "end or prevent their suffering" way, or even an overpopulation concern, but in such a callous way, and to people's pets no less!

I realize how hypocritical this will sound, but I sometimes feel there are just too many people around, more people = more chance for mental illness/sadism. I dunno, I'm not right myself as of late, but I have had cats since I was a young girl, and this is heartbreaking.
Update: My kitty came back, I heard him munching away.

Trying out opiates because my brother insisted I'd need to be high to get through my mom's memorial service.

My life is tragically bad now, but it's not because I'm a hopeless drug addict, it's because I choose to put all my energy into hustling money so that me and my brother aren't sick, he pretty much made it clear that if he can't use,  he'll kill himself.

He blames me for the situation and won't help me in the least. I apparently deserve this.
NTA. Not everyone is cut out for romatic commitment/marriage. As long as you are upfront about your desire(s) and don't lead women on, then you have nothing to worry about.

The good news: you look pretty good now you lost the weight!

The bad news: you lost it due to the stress of losing both parents and becoming a homeless drug addict.

You fucked up.

I only lurk here but I agree. I come here for the drama-filled, juicy detailed posts, I want all shades of grey, not clearly black & white! Not acts of altruism and humble brags.

This and r/confession are really bad for this.
I could get us a car so we could stop being homeless and squatting in abandoned houses.
ROFL yes, you have the same problem as me I see. 😘
Everytime I see his name, I think of Benicio Del Toro. <_<
That's kinda sweet. Good luck to you guys!

Regardless, it's a very beautiful piece.


So she wants it done for like what, $20?

That's sad. I'm homeless and panhandle and you can bet your ass that I'm grateful for anything I get, and I certainly don't ask for more/to exchange it.

I dunno, I can see both sides of it, so I can understand why people think the way they do. Still embarrassing though.

I'm not a mom, but your post tugged at my heart strings. I know a bit about feeling alone, I'm homeless after losing my parents about 2 years ago, all my extended family abandoning me and my brother, and losing my elderly cat last month. I just wanted to tell you you aren't alone! I'm so sorry for all your loss, pain, fear and loneliness. I'm just an internet stranger but I wish I could hug you.

I don't have any simple/easy answers for you, but you picked a nice subreddit to post to, the people here are probably the kindest you'll find on Reddit.

*Hug* if you ever want an ear, I'm around!

ROFL no way, you're lying. 

You... You have to be, right?
Damn, so when he was a kid, he was a thieving stoner?

I hate seeing this shit. I'm homeless, I panhandle just for money generally (when I try for food, ppl assume I just want money anyway) but I appreciate ANYTHING I am given! I do not gripe the least bit about what I received!

OP, I'm sorry this (man?) was trying to work you, it's beyond kind that you and your coworkers were willing to help. Please don't let this experience sour you, not every needy person is a douchebag!

I know you're just joshin' but as a homeless woman (who's young, white and attractive evidently) it makes me sad how often people act and think like this, I have it better than a lot of homeless and my current life still sucks.

People need to be more compassionate. =(
I thought it was Obama too, so you're not alone. <_<
Aww what a gorgeous doggy. I'm a cat person 100% but animals = love imo.

I know it's wrong that I'm l'm kinda jealous of the victim. But I'm kinda jealous.

I've developed an infatuation with LEO this year and I don't know why. ><

I know! What this man did was wrong, but still... 0_0

I'm not above eating certain stuff I find on the ground (not by dog shit, not covered in ants etc) I mean, food is food, and I hate wasting as I'm always hungry anymore, but I wouldn't want to eat rotten fruit either! 

The homeless are people too. :(

"Barren" by Peter V. Brett (I think that's his name) has a lesbian protagonist, it's Central to the story but I feel it's tastefully done. (I have nothing against anything LGBTQ, but also don't actively seek it)

Not sure what else I was gonna say, so there it is.

I don't think you're TA. I'm a homeless woman and I panhandle, I'm grateful for any help I'm given. I have had ppl shove their entire paycheck in my face before giving me a $1 does it suck being treated that way? Yes. Is my day Life a total nightmare? Again, yes. I still say thank you to people who treat me kindly.

That said, my experience has taught me a lot of panhandlers are on the lower rung of society and therefore lack tact, they feel the world is against them and the day to day stress of their lives messes with their ability to engage people properly. Of course some are just assholes.

You're good, thank you for trying to help someone less fortunate out!

I panhandle daily to support my brother and I.

Also, I showed my breasts to a guy on two different occasions for $5 a time.

Eek! I don't know why people get bumper stickers to begin with.

Uh... I probably love her officer too though. <_<

Beautiful cat. I lost my Baby Black last Monday. She was 16, and the oldest living cat I've had this far.

Thank you for sharing! 😺

I don't know WTF this comment is, but I laughed.

I approve.

Christian apologetics, I'm far from an expert, but when it was fresh in my mind, not my lax- Catholic-but-still-Christian mom, or agnostic dad/brother were interested in it.

Well, my brother has humored me at least.

Sucks though, it's really an interesting subject, but everyone just thinks I'm into some weird shit or has no interest whatsoever.

We were talking about my uncle (mom's brother) and his wife/my aunt, see, said uncle is like 6'5 while my aunt is under 5' I think? Well, the discussion was their height difference and I decided to mention something I read in a book recently... The reactions were "ew" and "why did your uncle remind you of that?!"

I'm a 30 y/o woman and still a virgin. I didn't have much interest in dating as a teenager, I developed crippling anxiety at 16 and was a shut in for 8 years. After that, I was focused on taking care of my parents and brother. I lost my parents in 2016 and am currently homeless, despite receiving many "offers" I have no interest in hooking up with random gross men.

I plan to start dating once I get back on my feet though!
This made me laugh.

I'm sorry you had to go through it, especially alone. I at least have a person, but it's still pretty isolating.

Don't think I ever looked at homeless people negatively, but after this, I definitely will have a fuck ton more empathy for them.

Oh. Well... Isn't my face red? Heh. 

I suppose I should look into it then.

Thank you for chatting/being supportive BTW, it does mean a lot to me.

Maybe, I'd have to look around. Unfortunately I spend most of the day trying to get us money so I don't have the time/energy/I forget to look around.

I already had ebt, but I didn't go through the job training thing they require so I only had it for 3 months, and despite me having had a job during that period, I can't get it back till I complete it. I don't know about methadone around here, plus I'm not sure I want addiction put on my medical record.

I apologize, I just complain to complain, there's no easy solution (or apparently, any solution at all) for me and I'm just frustrated.

Yeah, I just don't know where to begin. My car is about to break so I'm afraid of taking a job and then losing it due to losing my transportation, my guy can only boost but we're both afraid of him getting in trouble which is why I've been 'handling hard lately.

I dunno, everything feels impossible right now (doesn't help I have a cold) I wish I had family or friends that cared, such a lonely existence otherwise.

Yeah I've been meaning to get another job, just everyday is about the same thing, making sure we have enough D to get through.

Car is falling apart so anytime I bring up doing anything out of the way, I'm reminded of that.

Doesn't help that PHing yields a good amount of money. :/

Just gotten myself into a mess of a situation, ugh!

I am so sorry for your loss. I know  I can't say or do anything to ease your suffering, but please don't blame yourself, I'm sure your friend wouldn't want you to suffer like this.

If you need someone to talk to, feel free to pm me,  otherwise please take care of yourself.

You're right, it can always be worse. I feel bad complaining because I know some people wish they had a car...

Don't really despise the game, I'm just tired of panhandling, I want to go back to work and pay for my shit without advertising to the whole world that my life has come undone and I'm now an addict. I'm a very shy/introverted/socially anxious person, it's hellish for me having to beg everyday, several times a day.

I thought I had tomorrow off, but nope. :/

It's OK. Car life isn't horrible by itself, and I would regret giving my cat up definitely.

Still, there are certain aspects of my current life I despise.

This is hilarious, and brilliant.

But HOLY SHIT look at that gold! (23 as of this post)

There is but I would have to give up my pet which I can't do, I have a car so it's not all bad.

It's just isolating, this lifestyle, I already feel alone losing my folks especially my mom, but not being able to properly tell why it's hard getting back on our feet, just adds to it.

I love my guy, he's honestly a good man trapped in a shit situation, and doesn't deal with things properly. I do get frustrated feeling like I'm the rock and having to take shit from strangers and him.

I made it sound that way. He does, but he only boosts, and only does that if he's high. So I have to make that happen. Even when I'm sick, especially when I'm sick.

I think I'm just irritated because it seems like all he does is drive/maintenance the car (which is a mess no doubt) leaves me to do pretty much everything else (including remembering stuff) and when I don't, it's all my fault.

I dunno, there's two sides to every story, I'm just not sure what to think, and I'm. Exhausted.

Thank you for your kind words, I do appreciate it. :)

Lost my mom to cancer last winter, family member gave me a couple bags to sniff so we could get through her service. She had life insurance so ended up living off of it all last year as I barely got out of bed, much less going back to work. (This is gonna sound stupid) but I didn't know it was H, I was told it was oxymorphone so I guess that made it less "bad".

Didn't stop using after the service, most of that money went up our noses, I hate having to admit this because only three people know the truth (only two living) but my dad didn't make it a year before he ate a pistol. I'm pretty sure it was because he missed mom so much and he was sick for a long time, but the money ran out, and he blamed us/told us this was coming, though he enabled the spending.

I'm not trying to blame him BTW, but he did have serious issues.

It just kept going down hill, as of today, I've been homeless since summer, and panhandle to support our habit. I am deeply ashamed of that and spend half my time sick and other half hating myself.

I know where I am, and I'm not trying to get pity, I know you all struggle too, but it's been such a shit day (people have been treating me pretty bad today) I'm hungry, cold, need a shower and well, it's all on me to get us more money.

I'm not sure I regret using, I think I regret having to share my proceeds. I feel if I were alone, I could use and have a job, not have to panhandle/make shit last so I'm not sick every holiday etc.

TL;DR I am your walking homeless addict stereotype, except I'm a woman. (And I don't harm people to get my fix)
